# BetterHud

`paper-plugin/src/main/java/dev/cim/hud/HudLayout.java` uses the glyph position
technique from [BetterHud](https://github.com/toxicity188/BetterHud) by
toxicity188: a font ascent carries a layout id, `core/text.vsh` decodes it, and a
boss bar with transparent sprites carries the text. Used under the MIT licence in
this directory.
